Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Telecom Telecel Ghana rewards subscriber with Hyundai Creta in 15th Dream Car promotion Source : Helen Naa Kai Aryee 27 October 2026 8:12pm Audio By Carbonatix
Telecel Ghana has rewarded a lucky subscriber, Eric Ayamgash, with a Hyundai Creta at the end of the 15th cycle of its Dream Car promotion.
The initiative forms part of the telecommunications company's efforts to reward customer loyalty and support the aspirations of its subscribers.
Senior Manager in charge of Mobile Data at Telecel Ghana, Carlos Asare Oppong, says the promotion reflects the company's commitment to creating rewarding experiences and helping customers achieve their dreams.
He disclosed that the latest presentation marks the eighth car awarded under the promotion, in addition to six houses given to winners over the programme's 15 cycles.
“We believe that Ghanaians are very aspirational, and as an aspirational brand, we want to be able to support our customers to achieve their dreams and their goals in life. That is why we launched the Dream Car promotion about 15 cycles ago,” he said.
Mr Asare Oppong also announced improvements to the 16th cycle of the promotion, including an additional GH¢100,000 cash prize expected to be awarded towards the end of November or December.
He further revealed that the next cycle will feature a bigger car, urging subscribers to remain active on the network and participate in the promotion for a chance to win.
Meanwhile, winner Eric Ayamgash expressed excitement and gratitude to Telecel Ghana, describing his win as a testament to the authenticity of the promotion.
He said after failing to win in the previous year's edition, he was determined to put in more effort in the subsequent cycle.
“Last year, I tried but I couldn't win. When I saw the video of the winner, I said to myself that the next one I'm going to try and put in more effort. God being so good, I was called that I am the winner for this cycle. I just want to say thank you very much, Telecel. I'm so grateful,” he said.
Mr Ayamgash encouraged other subscribers to participate, insisting that the promotion is genuine.
The Dream Car promotion, which is approved by the National Lottery Authority, gives Telecel subscribers the opportunity to win prizes by participating through the designated USSD platform.
Subscribers can dial *2018# on their Telecel SIM cards to take part in the promotion.
